title: Roast Canadian Roast with Kissed Roast Crust
description: A rich and savory roast dish featuring a flavorful crust made with kissed roast. A perfect centerpiece for a weekend dinner.

instructions.step: Rinse the Canadian roast and pat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped kissed roast, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Rub the roast with olive oil and coat with the kiss roast mixture.
Place the roast in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add sliced onion and carrots to the pot, surrounding the roast.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the roast reaches an internal temperature of 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the pot from the oven and add cubed potatoes to the pot.
Return the pot to the oven and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
